name: Feena
source: A young girl who is chosen as the sacrificial maiden of a sacred shrine. As the shrine is attacked by the demon lord, Feena escaped and sought the help of the spirit Demea. Together, they traveled through the land and sought to free the people from the demon lord's terror.
